description: PROP-AUTH-012 at auth-flow.test.ts:135-159 first test case uses the legacy 3-argument handleAuthRequest('/v1/auth/discord/callback', {}, frontendBaseUrl) which hits the legacy handler that always returns 302 without any validation. The test defensively checks 'if (response.statusCode === 302)' vs '401' but the legacy handler can never return 401 for callback. This test path is tautological for the legacy form: it always gets 302 regardless of input validity. The second test at lines 161-189 properly uses the structured form and is meaningful. The first test should be removed or rewritten to use the structured form exclusively.
